The operator chart installs the CRDs chart as a dependency by default, so CRD changes arrive with the operator upgrade unless the CRDs chart is installed separately. AKO 2.8.0

The mongodb-atlas-operator chart renders one Deployment (replicas: 1) that runs the manager with --leader-elect, plus RBAC templates whose Roles depend on watchNamespaces and crossNamespaceRoles, and an optional global credentials Secret that is created only when API key or client credentials are set. The CRDs are packaged in a separate mongodb-atlas-operator-crds subchart, which the operator chart includes as a conditional dependency. That subchart can also be installed and upgraded on its own with helm install and helm upgrade.
